messages:
alex: Hey — noticed a weird parity issue between the Node SDK and the REST embeddings endpoint. SDK returns an array of arrays for batch embed calls, REST returns a flat list. Broke our sample app transformer. :face_with_monocle:

maya: Ugh. Can you paste an example? Sounds like a shape mismatch in the client wrapper.

alex: Yep. REST curl returns:```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.12, -0.03, ...]}, {"embedding":[0.01, 0.11, ...]}]}
```

alex: Node SDK call we used:```js
const res = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1', input: ['a','b'] })
// res.data -> [[0.12, -0.03, ...], [0.01, 0.11, ...]]
```

sam: Oh that explains it. Our transformer expects data[i].embedding. SDK returning inner arrays trips it. Is this intentional?

zach: I think SDK simplified shape to just return raw vectors, but didn't document it properly. That is a breaking change for sample apps.

maya: @alex can you repro with an explicit single-item batch and non-batch? Might reveal whether SDK always flattens or only for batch.

alex: Single input -> rest: data[0].embedding (vector). SDK: still returns nested arrays but the wrapper puts vectors at res.data, not res.data[0].embedding. Inconsistent.

alex: Also noticed parameter drift: REST accepts "model" + "input", SDK uses "modelName" and "texts" in older versions, but current docs show both. Confusing.

maya: Great catch. This is two bugs: 1) response shape parity, 2) parameter name drift. Both cause onboarding friction.

sam: We should add a compatibility layer in sample apps, but we also need an SDK fix. I'll open a quick PR to normalize to REST-shaped objects by default, with a flag to return raw vectors for perf users.

zach: Can we also add a deprecation-warning in the SDK when old param names are used? e.g., console.warn with a link to the migration guide.

alex: Yes please. Also: auth behavior differs if you pass an audience header in the env — REST token validation accepts multiple audiences but SDK's oauth flow enforces one and returns 401. That caused a weird CI-only failure.

maya: Oof. Can you file a ticket with reproduction steps + sample curl/node snippets? I'll tag eng-ml and eng-platform.

alex: Filed: https://tracker.internal/RED-4578 — includes curl + SDK snippet + failing CI log.

devx-bot: New issue created by maya: RED-4578 - "Embeddings: SDK/REST response shape mismatch, param name drift, and auth audience inconsistency". Assigned to @sam.

sam: I'll pick this up today. Plan: (1) replicate locally, (2) add SDK compatibility option, (3) add integration test comparing REST <> SDK shapes, (4) docs update. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maya: Thanks. For the docs update, add a migration snippet showing both patterns and how to enable "rest_shape" flag in client:```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ restShapeResponses: true })
```

alex: That will save a ton of support tickets. Also ping eng-runtime if we need to change API surface for hosted customers.

zach: Thx. Quick note: sample-apps repo needs a unit test to detect this shape drift so it fails CI if SDK shape != REST shape. Prevents future regressions.

sam: Agreed. I'll add the test in the PR.

alex: Appreciate it. Will follow up if CI still flakes. :thumbsup:
